exampleEn: Over the years, we simply grew apart and lost touch.
exampleKo: 세월이 지나면서 우리는 그저 서로 멀어지고 연락이 끊겼다.
gameExamples: As friends from childhood, we never thought we would grow apart, but life took us in different directions.
After graduating from college, many of my classmates started to grow apart as they settled into their new careers.
It was sad to see their friendship grow apart after so many years of closeness.
